verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a local CLI that users install themselves via Homebrew, Docker, or Go. It scans local git repos, directories, and stdin, so the core product runs entirely on the user's own infrastructure with no hosted dependency. missing for 10: explicit open-source license documentation in the evidence, independent/hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Gitleaks can be installed using Homebrew, Docker, or Go.
The `git` command lets you scan local git repos.
